review.result: Independent review identified repeated full scope proofs per attached sound during capture and Repeat-family inventory. Proof caches now use the full timing/historical-scope/live-scope tuple, retain per-owner validation, and install each historical layout once. Re-review found no further findings.
review.regression: Copy 64 sounds sharing one scope with 800 additional leaves; preserve all events and both clocks through validation, paste, serialization and inverse restoration.
review.withdrawn: A suspected recopy-of-outer-wrapper failure was withdrawn after confirming selection membership includes the complete selected subtree.
review.final_oracle_review: Independent follow-up found no findings in the corrected PCM oracle, rational Hold boundaries or per-occurrence clipping. Frame32 restores the original sample phase; its terminal-zero assertions are separate from the edge comparison mask.
corrections: focused-sound-clock-1: the new store test tried to deserialize FrozenAudioLayout directly. It now uses the bounded AudioBindingState validating reader.
focused-sound-clock-2: new audio test helpers used a nonexistent revision helper and indexed an iterator. They now construct RevisionId explicitly and use nth().

Between focused runs 2 and 3: independent review found repeated scope proofs per sound in slice capture and Repeat-family inventory. Full-tuple caches and one-time historical layout installation address it; the new 64-event/800-extra-leaf copy regression passes in focused run 3.

focused-sound-clock-3: 34 tests passed and six failed. Four core fixtures had an out-of-scope absolute range, an old root-journal shape, a lookup of a deliberately removed local sound, and an expectation of the old rather than freshly allocated copy timing ID. The corruption fixture hit SQLite foreign-key enforcement before injecting missing registry rows. The nested PCM fixture exceeded the per-read prepared-stage cap.

Core fixture corrections retain exact errors and identity assertions. The reordered-sibling regression now also exercises a cache hit populated by an unchanged earlier owner. The corruption test disables foreign keys only on its separate injection connection and verifies restored referential integrity afterward.
Root removed an identity iterator map and added alias rejection checks for foreign current/historical plan handles with equal contents.

After focused run3: the nested audio fixture groups its destination before clocks, captures from the post-return document, and uses 1024-sample reads without raising production limits. A same-gain source reference avoids scaling an already rounded f32 mix. Exact comparisons omit computed current Hold fade neighborhoods; separate checks cover silent gaps and the lost terminal sample of each outer play. A third recopy at frame32 checks that increased allocation cannot revive those labels.
clippy-1: the new routed_gate_fades_from API exceeded the argument-count lint. Its start/end edge policies now form one documented pair; the three call sites changed without altering gate behavior.
clippy-2: removed a redundant clone of Copy RegisterName and named the test stereo-PCM vector type to simplify its return signature. No lint suppression or production-limit change was added.

limits: Whole sound-bearing scopes only, surrounded by ordinary Sequence ancestors; partial sound owners and changed surviving processing branches remain guarded.
Root-owned temporal transport, occurrence isolation, allowances, tails, native beat-sound placement and complete ib/ab semantics remain open.
Register structural restore is distinct from qualified source admission at preview and commit.
Preserve reference PCM uses the canonical DSP engine and does not independently qualify that algorithm.
No optional app configuration, native GUI launch, acoustic or performance checks in this increment; copied attached sounds have no emitted-movie equivalence check yet.
No full-product requirement or release gate is complete.
